meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会添加 Teams 聊天支持：复制适配器、注册并构建，再引导你完成登录、创建机器人等步骤，让 Teams 频道、群聊和私聊都能对话。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Microsoft Teams 集成或设置 Teams 机器人时触发；若已有 Teams 凭证则跳过创建，直接进入重启或排障。

say.text: 帮我把 Claude 接入 Microsoft Teams
say.note: Claude 会开始复制适配器并引导你配置

say.text: 在 Teams 里为我创建一个机器人并连接
say.note: 会需要你提供公网 URL 和应用名称

say.text: 配置 Teams 频道集成
say.note: 按提示完成登录和安装即可

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds Microsoft Teams chat support: copies the adapter, registers and builds it, then walks you through signing in and creating a bot, so Teams channels, group chats, and DMs can chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Microsoft Teams integration or set up a Teams bot. If Teams credentials already exist, creation is skipped and the flow goes straight to restart or troubleshooting.

say_en.text: Help me connect Claude to Microsoft Teams.
say_en.note: Claude will start copying the adapter and guide you through setup.

say_en.text: Create a bot for me in Teams and link it.
say_en.note: You'll be asked for a public URL and app name.

say_en.text: Set up the Teams channel integration.
say_en.note: Follow the prompts to sign in and install.
